CREATE TEMP TABLE ddb_stage AS
WITH ddb_body AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM staging.customers AS c)
SELECT "customer_id", "name" FROM ddb_body;
DELETE FROM "marts"."dim_customer";
INSERT INTO "marts"."dim_customer" ("customer_id", "name")
SELECT "customer_id", "name" FROM ddb_stage;
DROP TABLE ddb_stage;
COMMIT;
